description: .gitlab-ci.yml security audit — Audit a GitLab CI/CD pipeline file offline. text= the .gitlab-ci.yml contents. Finds hardcoded secrets and token-format strings (never echoed), CI_DEBUG_TRACE, GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY, curl|bash, TLS verification disabled, StrictHostKeyChecking=no, attacker-controlled variables ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH, $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TITLE...) unquoted or in eval, secrets echoed or env dumped to logs, docker login -p, Docker-in-Docker without TLS, remote/unpinned includes, :latest images, artifacts publishing .env/keys/kubeconfig/tfstate, security scan jobs with allow_failure, deploy jobs on merge request pipelines or without rules/environment, missing SAST/Secret-Detection templates. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, a 0-100 score, findings with line, job and fix. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
